candidates.text: Before dispatching a fresh Engineer for a restarted Implementation phase, run git status and git diff on the target repo yourself. An interrupted Engineer may have left uncommitted in-scope edits that the checkpoint does not record. Name those edits in the fresh Engineer's dispatch prompt so it reads them and decides independently whether to adopt or revise them, rather than discovering unexplained changes mid-protocol. Then apply the normal TDD orchestration check (test-only change, no source change) before mediating its pre-test. Never revert the orphaned edits through orchestrator Bash.
